errorCodes.meaning: The witness service holds no witness identity with the submitted `witnessId`.
`logContent` does not verify as a did:webvh log — a broken hash chain, a bad controller proof, or a pre-rotation violation.
`versionId` is not the versionId of the last entry of `logContent`.
The entry's active witness parameter does not name this witness identity's DID, so its proof would witness nothing.

An earlier entry of `logContent` already set `parameters.deactivated: true`, and `versionId` names a *later* entry. A witness signs the entry that first deactivates a DID like any other entry, but refuses every entry after it.

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.

proof.description: The W3C Data Integrity proof over {versionId}, by the witness identity's key. Carried verbatim into the DID's did-witness.json; further Data Integrity members are permitted.

logContent.description: The did.jsonl up to and including the entry to witness, so the witness can verify what it signs.

versionId.description: The versionId of the log entry to witness. MUST be the last entry of `logContent`.

witnessId.description: The witness identity to sign with, as webvh/witness/key/list reports it.
